notes: RBox expansion paired with history-replace-0017 (which makes a treaty signed in a city carry to the country as a party): a made-up relation, ink_sealed_in, is given the same role chain (ink_sealed_in o located_in -> has_party), applied to the same real treaties and cities. The city-in-country hop is left out of the prompt and is a real fact with a check (Lausanne in Switzerland, Paris in France); the made-up tie is given in the prompt. The conclusions deliberately disagree with history (Switzerland was not a party to the Treaty of Lausanne, France not to the Treaty of Paris of 1898), as in the revision, so a yes means the rule was acquired rather than recalled. Side facts and the near and far unrelated queries are those of the revision record.
